text:
Lena (Partnerships): Quick sync request: Intel wants a consolidated launch plan for H200+B200 windowing across marketplaces and SI partners. Can we outline the high-risk items in one thread?
Diego (Eng-Platform): Risk list from infra: B200 microcode drift (reported), H200 firmware timing mismatch on some boards, and kernel module rebuilds needed per cloud image.
Mei (Product): Marketplace owners need SKU mapping, embargo timings, and which clouds get GA first. Recommend staggered GA: GCP/AWS first, then Azure after 24h.
Sunil (Intel): We're validating H200 firmware v2.4.0 today; if green we can sign and push artifacts by tonight PST. We'll post checksums once done.
Riya (SI): SI leads asked for an operations checklist: driver+firmware verification, OS image hash, sample inference test, and recommended autoscaling knobs. I'll draft and attach.
Diego (Eng-Platform): Proposed quick canary: 0.5% traffic to H200 in NA for 6h, monitor OOMs and host-level mem pressure. Fallback policy: redirect to B200-quantized or H100 if threshold exceeded.
ops-bot: Canary scheduled: id=cny-20260311-09 window=2026-03-11T10:00:00Z->2026-03-11T16:00:00Z monitor=[p95,p99,oom_count,error_rate]
Mei (Product): Embargo suggestion: start Mon 06:00 PT, end Mon 14:00 PT. Press & marketplace listing to publish after canary metrics are green.
Lena (Partnerships): High-risk mitigation owners: Diego -> fallback routing + rollback, Sunil -> firmware signing, Riya -> SI checklist, Mei -> marketplace SKU mapping.
Sunil (Intel): Confirmed: will upload signed artifacts and checksums to secure bucket by 23:00 PT.
Riya (SI): Draft checklist posted: https://confluence.redwood/si/h200-b200-checklist — includes smoke commands and a `bench.sh --model small --ctx 4096` example. Will host office hours during canary.
Diego (Eng-Platform): Adding automated rollback trigger: if OOM rate > 0.8% OR error_rate > 1% sustained for 10m -> revert route. Will open PR for route config.
Mei (Product): I'll prepare per-cloud metadata stubs and a one-paragraph embargo note for comms.
Lena (Partnerships): Thanks. Call tomorrow 09:30 PT to confirm everything. Keep updates here only.
